extDescription.message: Send pages and selections to your local Second Brain GD, and let it open, add and close the tabs it opens. Talks only to 127.0.0.1.

cmdSendPage.message: Send this page to the Brain

pairIntro.message: Pair this browser with your Brain. In the app: Captures → Send from browser… → Pair a browser, then enter the code here.

allowOpened.message: Also let the Brain read the pages it opens (so you can say “add it”)

allowButton.message: Allow reading the pages the Brain opens

shortcutHelp.message: Shortcut: <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>B</kbd> sends the page. Right-click a selection to send just that.

dotPaired.message: Paired, not connected (is the app open?)

stateUnreachable.message: Paired, but the Brain is not reachable on port $VALUE$. Open the app; it reconnects by itself.

enterCode.message: Enter the code shown in the app.

withoutPermission.message: Without it, voice commands cannot add the pages the Brain opens; clicking Send still works.

unreachablePair.message: The Brain is not reachable on 127.0.0.1:$VALUE$. Is the app open, and is the port right?

unreachable.message: The Brain is not reachable on 127.0.0.1:$VALUE$. Is the app open?

notPairedYet.message: Not paired yet: open this extension and enter the code shown in the app.

onlyHttpOpen.message: only http/https pages can be opened

noOpenedPage.message: no page opened by the Brain is open: say “add this page” for the tab in front

cannotSend.message: this page cannot be sent (only web pages, not browser or extension pages)

mayNotRead.message: the extension may not read pages yet: open it and click “Allow reading the pages the Brain opens”

nothingSelected.message: nothing is selected on the page

menuImage.message: Send this image to the Brain

menuPage.message: Send this page to the Brain

menuSelection.message: Send the selection to the Brain
